PIN RECEIVED!!! Liverpool get ready, my bestfriend is finally coming!!! 🎉🎉🎉

@Lorna Villaruz, I am so happy I cannot even type properly!! Thank you Lord, your NMC PIN came through today and now we can really say it, you are officially a registered nurse in the UK!!! All those papers, exams and waiting waiting waiting, and now LOOK AT YOU ❤️🙏

From nursing school in Iloilo to Liverpool, can you believe it? Our capping ceremony was in 1996 and I can still see the two of us with our white shoes, polishing them every night in the dorm. Well, MY polish, because this woman always borrowed mine and never bought her own 😂 Lorna, you can bring dried mangoes but I think you still owe me about 30 years of shoe polish haha.

When I left for the UK in 2004 you cried at the airport and told me “susunod ako”, I will follow you. Well you did not say WHEN, did you?? 22 years later!!! 😂 I have been telling you come here, come here, for about 20 years. Finally you listened to me. Ben will be very happy because now somebody else can listen to all my talking.

After Riyadh and Dubai, almost 18 years of looking after people there, it is Liverpool’s turn to have you. You are the best nurse I know, my friend. Always calm, always making the patients feel somebody is really listening. They love you because you care, and that is something I have known about you since we were student nurses. Ward 7, you are very lucky ❤️

She lands at Manchester on 14 January 2027, then starts work on 25 January on medical Ward 7 at Mersey Bank Hospital!! Induction first, then preceptorship, then probably me asking every evening how was your day, did you eat, are your feet cold 😂

The spare room is waiting for your first month with us. Ben says yes, so no more asking are you sure!! Thick duvet ready because after Dubai you are going to think our house is inside the freezer. When you came for your OSCE in Nottingham I sent you a photo of the rain, so you cannot say I did not warn you haha.

Please bring a PROPER COAT. Not a little cardigan and confidence. Liverpool wind does not care how brave you are 😂

And to our Filipino family here, help me welcome my Lorna!! Next year we will have you with us for the Christmas parties, the food, all the talking, and Simbang Gabi together. Finally no more just telling you about everything afterwards, you will be HERE.

Congratulations my sister from another mother. Same friendship from those white-shoe days, just thicker coats now. Liverpool is waiting for you and so are we!!! Love you, see you in January!! ❤️🎉🙏
